title: get health check status and uptime
description: Test the GET /health endpoint to verify it returns a 200 status with a JSON body containing status 'ok' and a numeric uptime value representing the server uptime in seconds.

title: list all smart home devices
description: Test the GET /devices endpoint to ensure it returns a 200 status with a list of all smart home devices including Light, Thermostat, and Lock with their current states.

title: get single device by valid id
description: Test the GET /devices/:id endpoint with an existing device ID to verify it returns a 200 status and the correct device object.

title: get single device by invalid id
description: Test the GET /devices/:id endpoint with a non-existent device ID to verify it returns a 404 status with a 'Device not found' error message.

title: update device properties with valid data
description: Test the PATCH /devices/:id endpoint with valid update fields such as {"on":true} for Light, {"temperature":72} for Thermostat, and {"locked":true} for Lock, verifying a 200 status and the updated device object.

title: update device properties with invalid data
description: Test the PATCH /devices/:id endpoint with invalid field types such as {"brightness":"high"} to verify it returns a 400 status with an 'Invalid fields' error message.

title: update device with non existent id
description: Test the PATCH /devices/:id endpoint with a non-existent device ID to verify it returns a 404 status with a 'Device not found' error message.

title: reset all devices to default state
description: Test the POST /reset endpoint to verify it resets all devices to their default states and returns a 200 status with a confirmation message.

title: reset devices after update
description: Test the sequence of updating a device property via PATCH /devices/:id, then calling POST /reset, and finally GET /devices to verify the devices are reset to default states.

title: handle internal error on reset endpoint
description: Test the POST /reset endpoint behavior when an internal server error occurs, verifying it returns a 500 status with a server error message.
